basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original full-body game NPC design candidate, single character only, head to shoes fully visible, portrait composition with room around silhouette, softly vignetted dark neutral background. The provided Keeper image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: closely match its exquisite thin warm linework, luminous watercolor and gouache anime storybook rendering, detailed fabric folds, ornate gold embroidery, delicate face rendering, theatrical fairy-tale elegance. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not chibi. This NPC is a former visitor whose soul is trapped by the Keeper, now a theme park cast member. Subtle melancholy and eerie hospitality, no gore. Shared small gold star cast badge ties them to Keeper but DO NOT copy his hat, red hair, outfit or full mask. Distinctive age accurate face, clear costume design. No text, no labels, no watermark.

characters.name: 루멘
characters.role: 관람차 담당, 58세 남성. 가족과 별을 보러 왔다 붙잡힌 은퇴 천문 교사. 다정하지만 내려오는 시간을 기억하지 못한다.
characters.desc: Clearly older man around 58, visible fine wrinkles, lean long silhouette, gentle weary face. Astronomer ferris-wheel cast uniform, navy and antique gold, constellation embroidery, gondola-key pendant and pocket star chart.
variants: silver swept-back hair, half-moon spectacles, long navy tailcoat with astrolabe shoulder cape, star-chart staff
salt-and-pepper wavy shoulder-length hair, round spectacles, short gold-trimmed observatory jacket and long scarf, brass telescope
white braided low ponytail, monocle, layered midnight blue ceremonial robe-coat with wheel-spoke embroidery, mechanical pocket watch

characters.name: 로제

characters.desc: 17-year-old girl, age-appropriate nonsexual cast costume, energetic stance with melancholy eyes. Carousel attendant and musician, ivory burgundy and antique gold, wooden-horse and music-box motifs, ribbon-bound score.

curly auburn high ponytail, striped puff sleeves, gold-trimmed burgundy waistcoat and tailored trousers, tiny violin

characters.desc: 29-year-old androgynous adult man, slender angular face, guarded expression. Mirror maze cast uniform silver black muted violet, asymmetrical reflective brocade, antique camera charm, fractured diamond motifs. A small partial masquerade mask, never copy Keeper face.
